name: The Criminal Element

angles.text: As a rogue, you know hidden caves behind waterfalls make familiar bandit hideouts. "Badwind" Bennic and his crew lack the care to stay out of the locals' sight and escape their anger.

faq.answer: "Badwind" Bennic leads the Highlands Bandits from a hidden cave behind a waterfall in the Shen'dar Highlands. His gang has long plagued the area, and the recent turmoil has made them an even greater terror.
The Highlands Bandits hide in a cave behind a waterfall to the north in the Shen'dar Highlands.
faq.q: Where are the Highlands Bandits hiding?

faq.answer: The cult is a new and alarming faction whose followers gather at Falaath Village to the south, and whose numbers are growing. The bandits were here before the cult arrived, but its presence has made the region more dangerous. Local forces worry that surviving bandits may seek refuge with the cult and strengthen its ranks.
faq.q: What is the cult mentioned in the area?

faq.answer: Local forces are stretched thin by the emerging cult and lack the manpower to clear out the bandits. Bringing Bennic down and scattering his gang removes an active threat from the region.
faq.q: Why can't local forces handle the bandits themselves?

faq.answer: With Bennic defeated, the bandits' hideout is scattered, but surviving outlaws may seek protection with the nearby cult and swell its already alarming numbers.
faq.q: What happens to the bandits after Bennic is defeated?

faq.answer: The Highlands Bandits roam the Shen'dar Highlands, where they keep a hidden cave behind a waterfall.
faq.q: Where does this conflict take place?

sections.body: The Highlands Bandits have made their den in a hidden cave behind a northern waterfall in the Shen'dar Highlands. Their leader, "Badwind" Bennic, commands cutthroats who troubled the locals long before an enigmatic cult arrived. Since then, their lawlessness has grown into terror. Local defenders are stretched thin and cannot spare forces, so you are sent to break the gang and bring Bennic down.
sections.title: Outlaws Behind the Falls

sections.body: After "Badwind" Bennic is eliminated, the Highlands Bandits lose their hold and the locals gain a brief respite. Yet surviving outlaws may seek shelter with the nearby cult. If it takes in these seasoned highwaymen, its ranks could swell and deepen the threat across the region.
sections.title: A Shift in the Shadows

summary: The Highlands Bandits terrorize the Shen'dar Highlands from a cave behind a waterfall. A new cult has arrived, and local defenders are stretched thin. So outside help is needed against the gang's leader, "Badwind" Bennic.
attribution: In-game quest text: The Criminal Element
